claude.sample_unit: patient education documents (six sets of PEMs across five pediatric conditions)

links.outcome: Mean grade reading level of PEMs by basic vs advanced plain-language prompt
links.effect: Advanced prompt AI documents had mean readability ≤6th grade, significantly better than basic prompt; ChatGPT advanced prompt mean grade level 5.8 (SD 0.84).
links.quote: Documents from generative AI using the advanced prompt and UpToDate had mean readability scores ≤ 6th grade, with significantly better readability than AI-generated documents using the basic prompt or HealthyChildren.org.

links.outcome: Understandability and actionability (PEMAT) of AI-generated patient education materials with plain-language prompt
links.effect: ChatGPT advanced prompt had 91% understandable and 84% actionable; advanced-prompt AIs exceeded the actionability threshold (>70%).
links.quote: All sources except HealthyChildren.org had mean understandability > 70%; AIs using the advanced prompt and UpToDate exceeded the actionability threshold.

links.outcome: Readability, understandability and actionability of outputs from advanced structured prompt vs basic prompt
links.effect: Advanced plain-language prompt produced PEMs that were readable, understandable, and actionable, with comparable results across ChatGPT and Gemini.
links.quote: A plain-language prompt for generative AI created PEMs that were readable, understandable, and actionable, with comparable results across two AI programs.

links.effect: ChatGPT advanced prompt: mean grade 5.8 (SD 0.84); PEMAT 91% understandable, 84% actionable.
links.quote: ChatGPT (advanced prompt) created PEM with the lowest mean grade reading level (5.8; SD 0.84) and highest PEMAT scores (91% understandable, 84% actionable).

links.effect: Advanced-prompt AI and UpToDate had mean readability scores ≤6th grade, better than basic-prompt AI or HealthyChildren.org.
